ideas.title: The Impact of the Federal Reserve Investigation on the Economy
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential impact of the DOJ's investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell on the economy.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the investigation on the economy?
How will the investigation affect the Federal Reserve's independence?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it could have significant implications for the economy and the Federal Reserve's independence. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the impact.

ideas.title: The Minnesota Childcare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the childcare fraud scandal in Minnesota and its impact on families and children.
questions: What is the extent of the childcare fraud scandal in Minnesota?
How has the scandal affected families and children?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it highlights the need for greater oversight and accountability in childcare programs. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the problem.
